subject.title: fix embedded compaction hook reset API

question: Should OpenClaw adopt a public, current-session-only `resetSession(reason?)` capability specifically for `after_compaction` plugin hooks?
rationale: The change adds a compatibility-sensitive plugin capability and the previous broader reset API closed unmerged, so code review cannot determine the permanent hook contract without feature-owner intent.

options.title: Approve after-compaction-only API
options.body: Adopt the deferred current-session API after restricting it to `after_compaction`, isolating its import graph, and adding positive live lifecycle proof.

options.title: Approve broader hook API
options.body: Explicitly allow other embedded hook phases to request post-run resets and document/test the supported phases and loop-prevention behavior.

options.title: Do not add core reset capability
options.body: Close the direction and require the requesting plugin to use existing externally owned orchestration until a different generic lifecycle seam is approved.

recommendation.title: Approve after-compaction-only API
recommendation.body: Adopt the deferred current-session API after restricting it to `after_compaction`, isolating its import graph, and adding positive live lifecycle proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged history introduced the compaction/reset hook surface and documented deferred lifecycle operations around these hooks.
